summary: AEVEX Corp. filed an 8-K announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization to acquire Maritime Applied Physics Corporation via a two-step merger through wholly owned subsidiaries. The aggregate consideration is based on a total enterprise value of $600,000,000, subject to customary working capital, cash, indebtedness, and expense adjustments. A post-closing adjustment of up to $5,000,000 is secured by an escrow deposit. The transaction is structured to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). No premium or per-share price disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions.
